title: CrmMoveDealStageInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win) — chain-authored config and DAG-forwarded inputs are both legal sources, so nothing is `required` here; the SURFACE refuses a missing key with a typed `validation_error` (a node failure, never success-with-empty).

stageId.description: Destination stage; `won`/`lost` status is derived from the stage name exactly as the org route does.
